0.original: The doomsaying dwarf wishes to send you to gather machine parts─and definitely not to your doom.

24.original: Obtain salvage in the Copied Factory.

25.original: Deliver the salvage to the doomsaying dwarf.

48.original: Ready to go to your doom─er...I mean, get to work, are you? Good, good.

49.original: As per the chief's instructions, your task is to gather items the machines left behind that might prove useful for rebuilding our village.

50.original: Do you know any suitable places for this?

52.original: The machines have a base deep in the tunnels.

53.original: There's a ruined factory strewn with machina.

55.original: While you're out there searching, I'll get my tools ready for dismantling.

56.original: I look forward to seeing the spoils of your foray!

57.original: How goes the search? I stand ready to dismantle the spoils of your foray!

58.original: Well, drench my beard, I've never seen anything like this... It's not going to suddenly spring to life and strangle me, is it?

59.original: No? Well, if you're sure... I'll set about studying it at once.

60.original: Oh, I should mention that the chief was looking for you. Seems he has news to share. It's something dreadful, I shouldn't doubt...

61.original: Have you spoken with the chief yet? Seems he has news to share. It's something dreadful, I shouldn't doubt...

62.original: Hm? Ready for another foray, are you? Well, if it wouldn't be too much of a bother...

63.original: Excellent! Let our inexorable march towards failure continue!

64.original: So, do you recall the machina you brought back last time? Unfortunately, they were rather far gone, and I couldn't salvage much of them. Do you think you could bring back more of the same?

68.original: Thank you! With the bits from the extra specimens, I think we can put together something useful─even if we're inevitably doomed to fail.

69.original: Please bring me more of the same machina as last time. With the bits from the extra specimens, I think we can put together something useful─even if we're inevitably doomed to fail.

70.original: Ah, yes, precisely the same as last time! This ought to suffice for our purposes, thank you!

71.original: You know, I've been feeling a little bit more optimistic in spite of myself. By keeping occupied with our work, I find my mind doesn't stray towards the doom and gloom as often as it used to. Seems it's better to take action than being idle with negative thoughts.

72.original: If only it weren't so hard to take action in the first place...

73.original: Well, I should be getting back to my work. Perhaps you could report to the chief, in case he has other tasks that want doing. Thanks again for bringing the parts!
